notes: Five entities; relation ids sit on the parent side.

value.name: Project
value.description: A requirements effort owned by one author, holding the whole generated document.

value.name: Document Version
value.description: An assembled snapshot of a project SRS at a point in time.

value.name: Chat Session
value.description: One conversation thread attached to a project.

value.name: Credit Wallet
value.description: The balance of AI credits an account can spend.

value.name: Credit Reservation
value.description: Credits held while an AI action runs, released or charged when it finishes.
